allowed_outcomes: efficiency improved without a scientific discovery improvement
conclusion.note: a pilot NEVER declares a winner; all four outcomes remain open until the frozen confirmatory analysis
conclusion.reason: the primary objective-quality metric has no complete human blind review, so no value claim can be made

limitations: only 3 eligible block(s): descriptive, not inferential
objective-quality reviews are not complete: at least two independent HUMAN reviewers must submit before that metric (and any contrast on it) can be reported
A/B objectives were selected by the recorded, pre-registered delegated-operator protocol, not by independent human researchers; this weakens any claim about human-vs-automation selection

sample_size.formula: n = ceil(((z_{1-alpha'/2} + z_{power})^2 * var_d * inflation) / seoi^2)
sample_size.multiple_comparison_correction: holm over 3 contrasts; power computed with the conservative Bonferroni-equivalent alpha
notes: pilot paired blocks are too few to estimate a trustworthy variance; only hypothetical standardised-effect rows are shown
sample_size.smallest_effect_of_interest_policy: pre-specified per contrast; the largest pilot effect is NEVER used
